definitions.explanation: Writing done quickly and carelessly, often illegible or abbreviated. Used for quick notes jotted down in a hurry.

examples.japanese: メモに{走|はし}り{書|が}きした。
examples.english: I scribbled it on a memo.

examples.japanese: {走|はし}り{書|が}きで{読|よ}みにくい{字|じ}だった。
examples.english: The writing was hard to read because it was scrawled.

examples.japanese: {電話|でんわ}の{内容|ないよう}を{走|はし}り{書|が}きで{書|か}き{留|と}めた。
examples.english: I jotted down the contents of the phone call in a hasty scrawl.

examples.japanese: {机|つくえ}の{上|うえ}に{走|はし}り{書|が}きの{付箋|ふせん}が{貼|は}ってあった。
examples.english: There was a hastily scribbled sticky note on the desk.

notes:
Composed of {走|はし}り (running) + {書|が}き (writing) — literally "running writing," conveying the idea of writing done at speed without care for neatness. Can function as a noun or as a suru verb ({走|はし}り{書|が}きする).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {走|はし}り{書|が}きする: scribble quickly
- {走|はし}り{書|が}きのメモ: a hastily scribbled note
- {走|はし}り{書|が}きで{書|か}く: write in a scrawl
- {走|はし}り{書|が}きで{読|よ}めない: can't read because it's scribbled

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {殴|なぐ}り{書|が}き: scrawl (rougher/messier connotation)
- {書|か}き{殴|なぐ}る: dash off writing angrily or carelessly
- {落書|らくが}き: doodling, graffiti (different nuance — not about speed)
